def compute_max_signal(slv_array, alpha=0.3):
    """Compute max controller signal magnitude (max negative EMA drop)."""
    ema = np.zeros_like(slv_array)
    ema[0] = slv_array[0]
    for t in range(1, len(slv_array)):
        ema[t] = alpha * slv_array[t] + (1 - alpha) * ema[t-1]
    delta = np.diff(ema)  # ΔS̃_t = S̃_t - S̃_{t-1}
    neg_deltas = -delta[delta < 0]  # only negative drops, flip sign
    if len(neg_deltas) == 0:
        return 0.0
    return np.max(neg_deltas)
